mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected future dividends and thereby depressing S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day moving average during the same month, or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.25% in the subsequent 10 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE by more than 0.2 percentage points coincides with reduced consumer confidence and tighter credit conditions, which suppresses corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
regime_hint: Rising unemployment and tightening labor market
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, SPX 60-day forward returns remain positive when UNRATE rises by >0.2%, or earnings momentum recovers in parallel with the rate increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the HOUST index exceeds 750 for two consecutive months, indicating strong industrial demand, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days are predicted to be positive due to optimism about business expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the qualifying HOUST period, or the trend reverses within 3 days after the second month of high HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO above 97.5 (2017=100) suggests persistent supply-side constraints, lowering market valuations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the identified supply contraction, or INDPRO recovers above 97.5 within the same horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, the expectation of lower future policy tightening supports higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the low-rate period, or FEDFUNDS rises above 2% within the next 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS by over 10,000 in a month coincides with layoffs in the services sector, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the layoff episode, or employment in services recovers in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising RSAFS above 400,000 suggest robust retail demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive during the high retail sales period, or the momentum fades within 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 7% for a month and CPIAUCSL is flat, the combination signals a labor market softening with muted inflation, lowering discount rates and pushing S&P 500 20-day forward returns negative.
regime_hint: Labor market easing with stable inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the regime, or CPIAUCSL rises while UNRATE remains below 7%.
